fullPassage: See the Future in Movies Several artificial intelligence (AI) technologies described in films are now a reality. One of them is self-driving cars. In Total Recall, for example, the taxi driver is the vehicle’s computer system. The taxi is capable of driving itself without any human intervention. Having seen that movie, many people wanted self-driving cars. Luckily, self-driving cars are being developed and certain versions are already on the road. Additionally, many other AI technologies from movies are either in use or under development. 2001: A Space Odyssey This movie, set in 2001, realistically describes a group of scientists on a spaceship heading to another planet. However, it was released in 1968, a year prior to the first moon landing. This means that human imagination goes far beyond reality. In the movie, the ship has a computer system, called “HAL-9000.” It provided the audience with the chance to understand AI. It could operate and regulate all of the spacecraft’s systems and help the astronauts conduct experiments by analyzing data. In one scene, the astronauts and HAL-9000 carry out a conversation about a faulty component of the spacecraft. Then, HAL-9000 makes a recommendation for the next step. The system could even draw logical conclusions and evaluate its decisions. The AI helper for a spaceship, which was only seen in the film at the time, has become a reality. In 2008, the International Space Station, a large spacecraft orbiting Earth, started to use an AI robot named CIMON. It is a floating spherical robot that can move around inside the spacecraft. CIMON, weighing only 5 kg, serves as a competent AI assistant for astronauts. The robot assists astronauts in more effectively accomplishing complex tasks by offering advice during experiments and work. It is also able to record and film the astronauts’ activities when asked. Minority Report Minority Report, a film set in the year 2050, was released in 2002. It features AI-based advertisements that can identify individuals from a remote distance by scanning people’s eyes. There is a scene where the main character enters a shopping mall. After scanning him and identifying who he is, the advertising system offers products that may be appealing to him. Nowadays, we frequently encounter personalized advertisements provided by AI. For instance, many online shopping malls, platforms for sharing videos, and social media use AI. Their AI systems provide us with advertisements based on our previous searches or other online behavior. Regarding the technology identifying people through scanning eyes, some devices have already been developed. However, those that do not use AI technology have a critical limitation. They can identify a person only if he or she is standing still. On the other hand, devices employing AI have overcome this limitation. They can scan people’s eyes when they are walking. There has been continuous development of this technology up until now. Big Hero 6 This is a science fiction animation that was released in 2014. There is a scene in the movie where a boy meets Baymax, a personal medical aid AI robot. The robot scans the boy’s body to detect potential health problems using its sensors and cameras. What it discovers within seconds is a wound in his arm. It administers medicine on the wound. In another scene where he has a mood swing, Baymax checks his hormone levels to determine the cause of his mood swing. These days, AI-based programs or robots are widely used in the medical industry. Some AI programs have been refined to the point that they can not only identify cancer quickly and accurately, but also predict the chance of getting cancer. AI robots are also used in operating rooms. Based on the collected data, AI surgical robots can conduct cognitive activities such as voice recognition, decision-making, problem-solving, and more. Under the guidance and control of doctors, they can conduct elementary operations such as cutting and stitching patients undergoing surgery. Another example is the development of an AI system to forecast when a hospitalized patient’s condition is likely to get worse. It analyzes the patient’s profile and data and assigns scores indicating the need for transfer to an intensive care unit. The medical team intervenes when a patient’s scores reach a certain level. AI in movies and our future AI has been progressing rapidly over the years, and its potential is only beginning to be fully recognized. It is certain that AI will continue to play a significant role in more and more aspects of our lives. Accordingly, these days, a lot of movies feature various kinds of AI. Some AI robots have personalities and emotionally engage with people in the same way that humans do. Furthermore, some AI characters are physically indistinguishable from humans. These movies are not only fun to watch, but also inspiring. They show us what AI might be like in the future and how it could affect us. What AI technology from a movie do you think will be used in our lives in the future?

questions.passage: In Total Recall, for example, the taxi driver is the vehicle’s computer system.  The taxi is capable of driving ①<u>themselves</u> without any human intervention.  Having seen that movie, many people ②<u>wanted</u> self-driving cars.  Luckily, self-driving cars are being ③<u>developed</u> and certain versions are already on the road.  Additionally, many other AI technologies from movies are either in use or under ④<u>development</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① themselves → itself (단수 주어 The taxi의 재귀대명사)
det.analysis:
❌ ① themselves → itself: 'The taxi is capable of driving ___'에서 운전하는 주체가 'The taxi(그 택시)'로 단수다. 주어와 목적어가 같을 때 쓰는 재귀대명사도 단수 itself(택시 자신)여야 한다. 복수 themselves는 단수 주어와 맞지 않아 틀리다 ← 정답

✅ ② wanted: 'many people wanted self-driving cars(많은 사람이 자율주행차를 원했다)'는 과거의 일을 나타내는 과거시제로 알맞다

✅ ③ developed: 'cars are being developed(차들이 개발되고 있다)'는 차가 '개발되는' 대상이므로 수동을 뜻하는 be being + 과거분사로 알맞다

✅ ④ development: 'under development(개발 중인)'는 전치사 under 뒤에 오는 명사로 알맞다
det.tip: 단수 주어 The taxi → 재귀대명사도 단수 itself

questions.passage: 2001: A Space Odyssey This movie, ①<u>set</u> in 2001, realistically ②<u>describe</u> a group of scientists on a spaceship heading to another planet.  However, it was released in 1968, a year prior to the first moon landing.  This means that human imagination goes far beyond reality.  In the movie, the ship has a computer system, called “HAL-9000. ” It provided the audience with the chance ③<u>to understand</u> AI.  It could operate and regulate all of the spacecraft’s systems and help the astronauts conduct experiments by ④<u>analyzing</u> data.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② describe → describes (주어가 단수 This movie)
det.analysis:
✅ ① set: 'This movie, set in 2001(2001년을 배경으로 한 이 영화)'에서 영화는 배경이 '설정되는' 대상이므로 수동을 뜻하는 과거분사 set이 알맞다

❌ ② describe → describes: 이 문장의 진짜 주어는 'This movie(이 영화)'로 단수다. 중간에 낀 'set in 2001'에 헷갈리면 안 된다. 단수 주어에는 단수 동사가 오므로 'This movie ... describes(이 영화는 묘사한다)'가 맞다 ← 정답

✅ ③ to understand: 'the chance to understand AI(AI를 이해할 기회)'에서 앞의 명사 chance를 꾸미는 to부정사로 알맞다

✅ ④ analyzing: 'by analyzing data(데이터를 분석함으로써)'에서 전치사 by 뒤에 오는 동명사로 알맞다
det.tip: 주어 This movie(단수) → 단수 동사 describes

questions.passage: These days, AI-based programs or robots are widely ①<u>used</u> in the medical industry.  Some AI programs have been refined to the point that they can not only identify cancer quickly and accurately, but also predict the chance of getting cancer.  AI robots are also used in operating rooms.  Based on the collected data, AI surgical robots can conduct cognitive activities such as voice recognition, decision-making, problem-solving, and more.  Under the guidance and control of doctors, they can conduct elementary operations such as cutting and stitching patients ②<u>undergoing</u> surgery.  Another example is the development of an AI system to forecast when a hospitalized patient’s condition is likely to get worse.  It analyzes the patient’s profile and data and assigns scores ③<u>indicated</u> the need for transfer to an intensive care unit.  The medical team ④<u>intervenes</u> when a patient’s scores reach a certain level.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ indicated → indicating (능동을 나타내는 현재분사)
det.analysis:
✅ ① used: 'AI-based programs or robots are widely used(AI 기반 프로그램이나 로봇이 널리 사용된다)'는 대상이 '사용되는' 것이므로 수동태로 알맞다

✅ ② undergoing: 'patients undergoing surgery(수술을 받고 있는 환자들)'에서 환자가 수술을 '받고 있는' 상태를 나타내므로 현재분사 undergoing이 알맞다

❌ ③ indicated → indicating: 'assigns scores indicating the need(필요성을 나타내는 점수를 매긴다)'가 핵심이다. 점수가 필요성을 '나타내는' 능동 관계이므로 현재분사 indicating이 맞다. 과거분사 indicated(수동)를 쓰면 '나타내어지는' 뜻이 되어 어색하다 ← 정답

✅ ④ intervenes: 주어 'The medical team(의료팀)'은 하나의 집단이라 단수 취급하므로 단수 동사 intervenes가 알맞다
det.tip: scores가 need를 나타냄(능동) → 현재분사 indicating

questions.passage: Minority Report Minority Report, a film set in the year 2050, was released in 2002.  It features AI-based advertisements that can identify individuals from a ①<u>remote</u> distance by scanning people’s eyes.  There is a scene where the main character enters a shopping mall.  After scanning him and identifying who he is, the advertising system offers products that may be ②<u>annoying</u> to him.  Nowadays, we frequently encounter ③<u>personalized</u> advertisements provided by AI.  For instance, many online shopping malls, ④<u>platforms</u> for sharing videos, and social media use AI.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② annoying → appealing: 시스템이 그에게 '매력적일' 상품을 제안
det.analysis:
✅ ① remote: 'identify individuals from a remote distance(먼 거리에서 사람을 식별)'는 AI 광고가 원거리에서 눈을 스캔한다는 문맥에 적절하다

❌ ② annoying → appealing: 'the advertising system offers products that may be ___ to him'에서, 광고 시스템은 그에게 '매력적일(appealing)' 만한 상품을 제안한다가 맞다. annoying(짜증나게 하는)은 상품을 권하는 흐름과 정반대라 부적절하다 ← 정답

✅ ③ personalized: '맞춤형(personalized) 광고를 자주 접한다'는 문맥에 적절하다

✅ ④ platforms: '영상 공유 플랫폼(platforms for sharing videos)'이 AI를 사용한다는 예시로 적절하다
det.tip: 상품을 권함 → appealing(매력적인), annoying(짜증나는) 아님

questions.passage: There is a scene in the movie where a boy meets Baymax, a personal medical aid AI robot.  The robot scans the boy’s body to detect potential health problems using its sensors and cameras.  What it discovers within seconds is a wound in his arm.  It ①<u>administers</u> medicine on the wound.  In another scene where he has a mood swing, Baymax ②<u>checks</u> his hormone levels to determine the cause of his mood swing.  These days, AI-based programs or robots are widely used in the medical industry.  Some AI programs have been ③<u>refined</u> to the point that they can not only identify cancer quickly and ④<u>poorly</u>, but also predict the chance of getting cancer.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ poorly → accurately: 암을 빠르고 '정확하게' 식별
det.analysis:
✅ ① administers: '상처에 약을 바른다(administers medicine)'는 문맥에 적절하다

✅ ② checks: '기분 변화의 원인을 알아내려 호르몬 수치를 확인한다(checks his hormone levels)'는 문맥에 적절하다

✅ ③ refined: '일부 AI 프로그램은 ~할 정도로 정교해졌다(have been refined)'는, 뒤에 이어지는 뛰어난 성능과 어울려 적절하다

❌ ④ poorly → accurately: 'identify cancer quickly and ___'에서, 정교해진 AI가 암을 '빠르고 정확하게(accurately)' 식별한다가 맞다. poorly(형편없이)는 프로그램이 정교해졌다는 앞 내용, 그리고 암 발병 가능성까지 예측한다는 뒤 내용과 정반대라 부적절하다 ← 정답
det.tip: 정교해진 AI가 암을 정확히 식별 → accurately, poorly(형편없이) 아님

These movies are not only fun to watch, but also inspiring.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 a significant role(중요한 역할)가 적절
det.analysis:
빈칸 앞에서 'AI의 잠재력이 이제 막 온전히 인식되기 시작했다'고 했고, 빈칸 문장은 'AI가 우리 삶의 점점 더 많은 부분에서 ___을 계속 할 것이 확실하다'는 내용이다.

❌ ① a minor role(사소한 역할): '점점 더 많은 부분에서'라는 확장 흐름과 어긋난다

✅ ② a significant role(중요한 역할): AI의 잠재력이 커지고 영향력이 넓어진다는 흐름에 딱 맞는다 ← 정답

❌ ③ a passive role(수동적 역할): AI가 적극적으로 역할을 넓혀 간다는 문맥과 어울리지 않는다

❌ ④ a temporary role(일시적 역할): 'continue to play(계속 ~한다)'와 모순된다
det.tip: 점점 더 많은 영역에서 계속 → a significant role(중요한 역할)

questions.passage: It could operate and regulate all of the spacecraft’s systems and help the astronauts conduct experiments by analyzing data.  In one scene, the astronauts and HAL-9000 carry out a conversation about a faulty component of the spacecraft.  Then, HAL-9000 makes a recommendation for the next step. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 has become a reality(현실이 되었다)가 적절
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 '한때 영화에서만 볼 수 있었던 우주선용 AI 도우미가 ___'라는 내용이고, 바로 뒤에서 '2008년 국제우주정거장이 CIMON이라는 AI 로봇을 쓰기 시작했다'고 실제 사례를 든다.

❌ ① has stayed science fiction(공상과학으로 남았다): 뒤에 실제 사례가 나오므로 반대다

❌ ② has faded from memory(기억에서 잊혔다): 실현되었다는 흐름과 반대다

✅ ③ has become a reality(현실이 되었다): 영화 속 상상이 실제 CIMON으로 구현되었다는 흐름에 딱 맞는다 ← 정답

❌ ④ has drawn public concern(대중의 우려를 샀다): 우려가 아니라 실현에 관한 내용이라 부적절하다
det.tip: 뒤에 실제 CIMON 사례 → has become a reality(현실이 되었다)

questions.passage: In 2008, the International Space Station, a large spacecraft orbiting Earth, started to use an AI robot named CIMON.  It is a floating spherical robot that can move around inside the spacecraft.  CIMON, weighing only 5 kg, serves as a competent AI assistant for astronauts.  The robot assists astronauts in more effectively accomplishing complex tasks by offering advice during experiments and work.  It is also able to record and film the astronauts’ activities when asked.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ④ '무능한 조수'가 오답 — 본문은 competent(유능한) (불일치)
det.analysis:
✅ ① 'In 2008, the International Space Station ... started to use an AI robot named CIMON'에서 2008년부터 사용되기 시작했다고 했으므로 일치한다

✅ ② 'a floating spherical robot that can move around inside the spacecraft'에서 우주선 내부를 돌아다니는 구형 로봇이라 했으므로 일치한다

✅ ③ 'able to record and film the astronauts' activities when asked'에서 요청받으면 촬영할 수 있다고 했으므로 일치한다

❌ ④ 본문은 'serves as a competent AI assistant(유능한 AI 조수 역할을 한다)'라고 했다. '무능한 조수'는 정반대이므로 일치하지 않는다 ← 정답
det.tip: competent(유능한) ↔ '무능한'은 정반대

ch: CIMON은 우주선 내부를 돌아다닐 수 있는 구형 로봇이다.
CIMON은 요청을 받으면 우주비행사의 활동을 촬영할 수 있다.
CIMON은 무게가 5kg에 불과해 우주비행사에게 무능한 조수로 여겨진다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.analysis:

❌ ③ 'we frequently encounter(자주 마주친다)'라고 했으므로 '매우 드물다'는 정반대라 틀리다

ch: AI 시스템은 사용자의 이전 검색이나 온라인 행동을 바탕으로 광고를 제공한다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ② '의사 관여 없이 스스로'가 오답 — 의사의 지도·통제 하 (불일치)
det.analysis:
✅ ① 'AI surgical robots can conduct cognitive activities such as voice recognition, decision-making'에서 수집된 데이터를 바탕으로 인지 활동을 한다고 했으므로 일치한다

❌ ② 본문은 'Under the guidance and control of doctors, they can conduct ... cutting and stitching(의사의 지도와 통제 하에 절개와 봉합을 한다)'라고 했다. '의사의 관여 없이 스스로'는 정반대이므로 일치하지 않는다 ← 정답

✅ ③ 'an AI system to forecast when a hospitalized patient's condition is likely to get worse'에서 환자 상태가 언제 나빠질지 예측한다고 했으므로 일치한다

✅ ④ 'The medical team intervenes when a patient's scores reach a certain level'에서 점수가 일정 수준에 이르면 의료팀이 개입한다고 했으므로 일치한다

ch: AI 수술 로봇은 수집된 데이터를 바탕으로 음성 인식 등 인지 활동을 수행할 수 있다.

questions.passage: See the Future in Movies Several artificial intelligence (AI) technologies described in films are now a reality.  One of them is self-driving cars.  In Total Recall, for example, the taxi driver is the vehicle’s computer system.  The taxi is capable of driving itself without any human intervention.  Having seen that movie, many people wanted self-driving cars.  Luckily, self-driving cars are being developed and certain versions are already on the road.  Additionally, many other AI technologies from movies are either in use or under development.  2001: A Space Odyssey This movie, set in 2001, realistically describes a group of scientists on a spaceship heading to another planet.  However, it was released in 1968, a year prior to the first moon landing.  This means that human imagination goes far beyond reality.  In the movie, the ship has a computer system, called “HAL-9000. ” It provided the audience with the chance to understand AI.  It could operate and regulate all of the spacecraft’s systems and help the astronauts conduct experiments by analyzing data.  In one scene, the astronauts and HAL-9000 carry out a conversation about a faulty component of the spacecraft.  Then, HAL-9000 makes a recommendation for the next step.  The system could even draw logical conclusions and evaluate its decisions.  The AI helper for a spaceship, which was only seen in the film at the time, has become a reality.  In 2008, the International Space Station, a large spacecraft orbiting Earth, started to use an AI robot named CIMON.  It is a floating spherical robot that can move around inside the spacecraft.  CIMON, weighing only 5 kg, serves as a competent AI assistant for astronauts.  The robot assists astronauts in more effectively accomplishing complex tasks by offering advice during experiments and work.  It is also able to record and film the astronauts’ activities when asked.  Minority Report Minority Report, a film set in the year 2050, was released in 2002.  It features AI-based advertisements that can identify individuals from a remote distance by scanning people’s eyes.  There is a scene where the main character enters a shopping mall.  After scanning him and identifying who he is, the advertising system offers products that may be appealing to him.  Nowadays, we frequently encounter personalized advertisements provided by AI.  For instance, many online shopping malls, platforms for sharing videos, and social media use AI.  Their AI systems provide us with advertisements based on our previous searches or other online behavior.  Regarding the technology identifying people through scanning eyes, some devices have already been developed.  However, those that do not use AI technology have a critical limitation.  They can identify a person only if he or she is standing still.  On the other hand, devices employing AI have overcome this limitation.  They can scan people’s eyes when they are walking.  There has been continuous development of this technology up until now.  Big Hero 6 This is a science fiction animation that was released in 2014.  There is a scene in the movie where a boy meets Baymax, a personal medical aid AI robot.  The robot scans the boy’s body to detect potential health problems using its sensors and cameras.  What it discovers within seconds is a wound in his arm.  It administers medicine on the wound.  In another scene where he has a mood swing, Baymax checks his hormone levels to determine the cause of his mood swing.  These days, AI-based programs or robots are widely used in the medical industry.  Some AI programs have been refined to the point that they can not only identify cancer quickly and accurately, but also predict the chance of getting cancer.  AI robots are also used in operating rooms.  Based on the collected data, AI surgical robots can conduct cognitive activities such as voice recognition, decision-making, problem-solving, and more.  Under the guidance and control of doctors, they can conduct elementary operations such as cutting and stitching patients undergoing surgery.  Another example is the development of an AI system to forecast when a hospitalized patient’s condition is likely to get worse.  It analyzes the patient’s profile and data and assigns scores indicating the need for transfer to an intensive care unit.  The medical team intervenes when a patient’s scores reach a certain level.  AI in movies and our future AI has been progressing rapidly over the years, and its potential is only beginning to be fully recognized.  It is certain that AI will continue to play a significant role in more and more aspects of our lives.  Accordingly, these days, a lot of movies feature various kinds of AI.  Some AI robots have personalities and emotionally engage with people in the same way that humans do.  Furthermore, some AI characters are physically indistinguishable from humans.  These movies are not only fun to watch, but also inspiring.  They show us what AI might be like in the future and how it could affect us.

det.korean: ① 인간의 상상은 현실의 기술보다 훨씬 앞서 나아간다
det.analysis:
밑줄 친 'goes far beyond reality(현실을 훨씬 넘어선다)'는, 이 영화가 첫 달 착륙(1969년)보다 1년 앞선 1968년에 이미 우주선과 AI를 그려 냈다는 앞 내용과 이어진다. 즉 인간의 상상이 당시 현실 기술보다 앞서 있었다는 뜻이다.

✅ ① 인간의 상상은 종종 현실의 기술보다 훨씬 앞서 나아간다: 달 착륙 전에 이미 우주 AI를 상상했다는 근거와 맞는다 ← 정답

❌ ② 영화는 실제 역사적 사건을 정확히 재현한다: 재현이 아니라 앞선 상상에 관한 말이라 틀리다

❌ ③ 과학 기술이 상상력보다 늘 빠르다: 오히려 상상이 앞섰다는 내용과 반대다

❌ ④ 우주여행은 영화 속 허구일 뿐이다: 그 상상이 현실이 되었다는 글의 흐름과 반대다
det.tip: 달 착륙 전에 우주 AI를 상상 → 상상이 현실보다 앞섬

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 Their가 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② 온라인 쇼핑몰, 영상 공유 플랫폼, 소셜 미디어
det.analysis:
밑줄 친 'Their(그들의)'는 바로 앞 문장에서 나열한 대상을 가리킨다. 'many online shopping malls, platforms for sharing videos, and social media use AI. Their AI systems provide us with advertisements ...'에서 AI를 사용하는 주체가 바로 그들이다.

❌ ① 쇼핑몰 방문객들: 광고를 받는 사람이지 AI 시스템을 가진 주체가 아니다

✅ ② 온라인 쇼핑몰, 영상 공유 플랫폼, 소셜 미디어: 바로 앞 문장에서 AI를 사용한다고 나열한 대상이므로 알맞다 ← 정답

❌ ③ 영화 속 주인공과 광고 시스템: Minority Report 장면 속 인물로, 이 문장의 주체가 아니다

❌ ④ 광고를 제작하는 광고주들: 본문에 언급되지 않은 대상이다
det.tip: Their = 앞 문장에서 AI를 쓴다고 나열한 플랫폼들

questions.passage: These days, AI-based programs or robots are widely used in the medical industry.  Some AI programs have been refined to the point that they can not only identify cancer quickly and accurately, but also predict __________.  AI robots are also used in operating rooms.  Based on the collected data, AI surgical robots can conduct cognitive activities such as voice recognition, decision-making, problem-solving, and more.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에 the chance of getting cancer(암에 걸릴 가능성)가 적절
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장은 '일부 AI 프로그램은 암을 빠르고 정확하게 식별할 뿐 아니라 ___도 예측할 정도로 정교해졌다'는 내용이다. 'not only A but also B(A뿐 아니라 B도)' 구조로, 암 식별과 이어지는 내용이 와야 한다.

❌ ① the price of new treatments(새 치료법의 가격): 암 진단이라는 문맥과 무관하다

❌ ② the number of hospital beds(병상 수): 암 예측과 관련이 없다

✅ ③ the chance of getting cancer(암에 걸릴 가능성): 암을 식별하는 것에서 나아가 암에 걸릴 '가능성'까지 예측한다는 흐름에 딱 맞는다 ← 정답

❌ ④ the cause of the common cold(감기의 원인): 암이 아니라 감기라 문맥에서 벗어난다
det.tip: identify cancer에서 나아가 → predict the chance of getting cancer

ch: the cause of the common cold

questions.passage: __________.  In Total Recall, for example, the taxi driver is the vehicle’s computer system.  The taxi is capable of driving itself without any human intervention.  Having seen that movie, many people wanted self-driving cars.  Luckily, self-driving cars are being developed and certain versions are already on the road.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 [조건]에 맞게 빈칸을 (영어로) 쓰시오.

그것들 중 하나는 자율주행차이다.

[조건] (1) cars, is, of, One, self-driving, them 를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 6단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: One of them is self-driving cars (6단어)
det.analysis: '그것들 중 하나는 ~이다'는 'One of them is ~'로 나타낸다. 주어는 'One of them(그것들 중 하나)'이고, 여럿 중 하나를 콕 집으므로 단수 취급해 be동사 is를 쓴다. 그 뒤에 보어 'self-driving cars(자율주행차)'를 놓는다. 순서는 One → of → them → is → self-driving → cars이다.
det.tip: One of them(단수 주어) + is + self-driving cars

questions.wa: One of them is self-driving cars
accept: One of them is self-driving cars

questions.passage: Based on the collected data, AI surgical robots can conduct ①<u>cognitive</u> activities such as voice recognition, decision-making, problem-solving, and more.  Under the guidance and control of doctors, they can conduct elementary operations such as cutting and ②<u>stitching</u> patients undergoing surgery.  Another example is the development of an AI system to forecast when a hospitalized patient’s condition is likely to get worse.  It analyzes the patient’s profile and data and ③<u>assigning</u> scores indicating the need for transfer to an intensive care unit.  The medical team ④<u>intervenes</u> when a patient’s scores reach a certain level.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 것을 하나 찾아 바르게 고쳐 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: ③ assigning → assigns (analyzes와 병렬을 이루는 정동사)
det.analysis:
✅ ① cognitive: 'conduct cognitive activities(인지 활동을 수행하다)'에서 명사 activities를 꾸미는 형용사 cognitive로 알맞다

✅ ② stitching: 'cutting and stitching(절개와 봉합)'에서 앞의 cutting과 나란히 이어지는 동명사로 알맞다

❌ ③ assigning → assigns: 'It analyzes the patient's profile and data and assigning scores'가 문제다. 접속사 and로 연결되는데 앞에 이미 정동사 analyzes(분석한다)가 있으므로, 뒤도 같은 형태의 정동사여야 한다. 주어 It(단수)에 맞춰 'and assigns scores(그리고 점수를 매긴다)'가 되어야 한다. 분사형 assigning은 병렬이 어긋나 틀리다 ← 정답

✅ ④ intervenes: 주어 'The medical team(의료팀)'은 하나의 집단이라 단수 취급하므로 단수 동사 intervenes가 알맞다
det.tip: analyzes and assigns: 접속사 and로 연결된 정동사 병렬(둘 다 단수현재)

questions.passage: Regarding the technology identifying people through scanning eyes, some devices have already been developed.  However, __________.  They can identify a person only if he or she is standing still.  On the other hand, devices employing AI have overcome this limitation.  They can scan people’s eyes when they are walking.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 [조건]에 맞게 빈칸을 (영어로) 쓰시오.

AI 기술을 사용하지 않는 것들은 중대한 한계를 지닌다.

[조건] (1) a, AI, critical, do, have, limitation, not, technology, that, those, use 를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 11단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: those that do not use AI technology have a critical limitation (11단어)
det.analysis: '~하지 않는 것들'은 대명사 those를 주격 관계대명사 that이 꾸며 'those that ...'로 만든다. '사용하지 않는다'는 일반동사의 부정이라 'do not use(사용하지 않는다)'로 쓴다. 이렇게 만든 긴 주어 'those that do not use AI technology(AI 기술을 사용하지 않는 것들)' 뒤에 동사 have와 목적어 'a critical limitation(중대한 한계)'을 놓는다. 순서는 those → that → do → not → use → AI → technology → have → a → critical → limitation이다.
det.tip: those that ...(관계대명사) + do not use + have a critical limitation

questions.wa: those that do not use AI technology have a critical limitation
accept: those that do not use AI technology have a critical limitation

questions.passage: One of them is self-driving cars.  In Total Recall, for example, the taxi driver is the vehicle’s computer system.  __________.  Having seen that movie, many people wanted self-driving cars.  Luckily, self-driving cars are being developed and certain versions are already on the road.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 빈칸을 (영어로) 쓰시오. (11단어)

그 택시는 어떤 인간의 개입도 없이 스스로 운전할 수 있다.

[단어] any, capable, driving, human, intervention, is, itself, of, taxi, The, without

det.korean: The taxi is capable of driving itself without any human intervention (11단어)
det.analysis: '그 택시는 ~할 수 있다'는 'be capable of + 동명사(~할 수 있다)' 구문을 쓴다. 주어 'The taxi' 다음에 is capable of를 놓고, '스스로 운전하다'는 driving 뒤에 재귀대명사 itself(택시 자신)를 붙여 'driving itself'로 만든다. 마지막에 '어떤 인간의 개입도 없이'는 전치사 without + any human intervention으로 이어 준다. 순서는 The → taxi → is → capable → of → driving → itself → without → any → human → intervention이다.
det.tip: be capable of + driving + itself(재귀) + without any human intervention

questions.wa: The taxi is capable of driving itself without any human intervention
accept: The taxi is capable of driving itself without any human intervention

questions.passage: These days, AI-based programs or robots are widely used in the medical industry.  Some AI programs have been refined to the point that they can not only identify cancer quickly and accurately, but also predict the chance of getting cancer.  __________.  Based on the collected data, AI surgical robots can conduct cognitive activities such as voice recognition, decision-making, problem-solving, and more.  Under the guidance and control of doctors, they can conduct elementary operations such as cutting and stitching patients undergoing surgery.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 [조건]에 맞게 빈칸을 (영어로) 쓰시오.

AI 로봇은 수술실에서도 사용된다.

[조건] (1) AI, also, are, in, operating, robots, rooms, used 를 모두 사용할 것 (2) 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: AI robots are also used in operating rooms (8단어)
det.analysis: 'AI 로봇은 ~된다'처럼 주어가 동작을 '받는' 경우는 수동태 'be동사 + 과거분사'로 쓴다. 로봇은 사람에게 '사용되는' 대상이므로 'AI robots are used(AI 로봇은 사용된다)'가 된다. '~도'라는 뜻의 부사 also는 be동사 뒤에 넣어 'are also used'로 만든다. 마지막에 장소를 나타내는 'in operating rooms(수술실에서)'를 붙인다. 순서는 AI → robots → are → also → used → in → operating → rooms이다.
det.tip: 수동태 are used + 부사 also(be동사 뒤) + in operating rooms

questions.wa: AI robots are also used in operating rooms
accept: AI robots are also used in operating rooms
AI robots also are used in operating rooms
